A former Huntingdonshire NHS clinic could become a new later living development with up to 40 homes. Churchill Living is proposing to redevelop St Ives Clinic, the old NHS premises on Ramsey Road, into a later living development. The scheme would include around 38 one- and two-bedroom apartments and two cottages, all designed for people over 60. The site is brownfield, meaning it was previously developed but is now abandoned, vacant or underused. A spokesperson for Churchill Living said: "As we prepare to submit a formal planning application, we are keen to gather feedback and give local people the opportunity to have their say on our plans to regenerate this previously developed site in the heart of St Ives. "Delivering new homes in this well-connected location will help to regenerate this brownfield site and reduce the need for greenfield development to meet the urgent demand for new homes locally.
